ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>85% of surface) with high-contrast low-intensity black borders and interior focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. Continuous black band along the trailing edge from tip to tip. Approximately seven discrete dark elliptical blobs distributed asymmetrically: two on the left lobe (upper and mid-section), and five on the right lobe (concentrated in the mid-to-lower quadrant).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 95 degrees, showing significant black pigmentation depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire margin. Prominent peaks and jagged valleys are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, transitioning to smoother irregular undulations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the notch transitioning to a slight convexity at the mid-lobe, ending in upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (3-12 pixels in diameter) scattered across the white ventral field, particularly visible in the right lobe upper quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear marks and light grey streaks visible on the lower ventral surface of the left lobe near the water interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy rugose dark texture and potential material accumulation at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating significant prior colonization or impact.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'splatter' pattern extending from the median notch into the lower white field.
